scientific_question: Does LAM-JEPA improve held-out grade-school science multiple-choice accuracy over fair non-JEPA baselines on AI2 ARC-Challenge under a predeclared evaluation protocol?

in_scope: grade-school science multiple-choice reasoning on AI2 ARC-Challenge
calibration on the same multiple-choice task
contribution of the latent-action planner and EMA target mechanism to this ARC result

dataset.name: AI2 ARC-Challenge

split_policy.validation: development, debugging, and model selection only
split_policy.test: single confirmatory evaluation stage after protocol, implementation, and validation-stage choices are frozen

dataset.leakage_rule: Any overlapping item ID across train, validation, or test invalidates the run. Test labels or test-derived metrics must not influence model or hyperparameter selection.

training_budget.budget_rule: LAM-JEPA and the matched-capacity supervised baseline use identical rows, epochs, batch size, seeds, optimizer family, and evaluation passes. The pretrained baseline uses the same rows, epochs, batch size, seeds, and evaluation passes; model-specific learning rate is predeclared and compute plus parameter counts must be reported rather than described as parameter matched.

matched_capacity_supervised_baseline.parameter_accounting: Match LAM-JEPA gradient-active/student capacity, excluding EMA-only target parameters that receive no optimizer gradients.
matched_capacity_supervised_baseline.forward_path_requirement: All counted matched-baseline parameters must participate in the supervised forward path.

strong_pretrained_baseline.parameter_matching: not parameter matched; report exact trainable and total parameters plus training wall time or equivalent compute evidence

metrics.uncertainty: paired seed-level 95% bootstrap confidence interval for LAM-JEPA minus each trained baseline

robustness.choice_order: deterministically reverse answer choices with exact label remapping and retain per-example paired predictions
robustness.failure_rule: A superiority claim is invalid if LAM-JEPA loses more than 0.05 absolute accuracy under the choice-order transform or is more than 0.02 worse than the strongest trained baseline on the same robustness delta.

negative_control.split: validation only; never use confirmatory test labels for the negative control
negative_control.failure_rule: If the shuffled-label LAM-JEPA exceeds 0.35 validation accuracy, stop and investigate leakage or shortcut behavior before any test evaluation.

ablations.mechanism_claim_rule: Do not attribute the ARC result to a component unless the paired full-minus-ablation mean accuracy is at least 0.01 and its paired 95% bootstrap confidence interval excludes zero.
ablations.student_state: No student-state contribution claim is made from ARC-Challenge, so this protocol does not use ARC to validate student-state modeling.

claim_gate.superiority: LAM-JEPA may be described as outperforming a baseline only if the mean absolute accuracy gain is at least 0.02 and the paired 95% bootstrap confidence interval for the seed-level accuracy delta excludes zero.
claim_gate.strongest_baseline_rule: Any headline superiority claim must hold against the strongest trained non-JEPA baseline, not only the majority reference or matched scratch baseline.
claim_gate.negative_results: If the gate fails, retain all raw outputs and report the negative or inconclusive result without changing the protocol after seeing test outcomes.

required: training duration or equivalent compute evidence
aggregate statistics derived from raw seed records
artifact_contract.independent_qa: Lane 08 must reproduce the immutable result commit before any RESEARCH_COMPLETE classification.

protocol_change_rule: Any material change after this file is merged requires a new protocol version before confirmatory test access. Never silently edit v1 in response to observed test results.
